title: Asian governments react to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s exit | TechCrunch
summary: On Sunday, November 8, Nvidia’s board launched an independent investigation after reports that Huang was targeted by a Chinese spy operation; Huang admitted to an affair with Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based chip company Megaspeed.
